# Sluss

> Sluss is a self-hosted, open-source AI gateway for EU organisations. Every question an employee or a tool sends to an AI model passes Sluss first: it is classified with fixed rules (never by an AI), routed under a fail-closed policy — personal data to the organisation's own hardware, nothing at all when no allowed model exists — and recorded in a hash-chained audit log. It speaks the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, runs as one container with SQLite, and is licensed AGPL-3.0. It is a control and evidence tool, not a certificate of legal compliance.

Agents installing or operating Sluss: read "Operate" first. Agents changing the code: read AGENTS.md.

## Operate

- [AGENTS.md — Deploying or operating Sluss](https://github.com/magnusfroste/sluss-eu/blob/main/AGENTS.md#deploying-or-operating-sluss): reading order and rules for an operating agent
- [Self-host with Docker](https://github.com/magnusfroste/sluss-eu/blob/main/docs/07-operations/self-host-docker.md): run, sign-in, TLS, upgrade, back up, air-gapped
- [Every setting](https://github.com/magnusfroste/sluss-eu/blob/main/deploy/example.env): the environment variables, explained
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/magnusfroste/sluss-eu/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): releases and which image to pin
